{"self_assessment": "Impact: The body is standing from START out along both edges, and the top fin is in. My bottom edge (36 dominoes) ran clean, and the nudge at its join closed a break that would have cut the fall short. I haven't seen the push, so I can't say whether the fish reads. I'd be guessing.

Execution: I laid the bottom edge steadily from START and it held. But I was slow to close the lower-arm join. Leo had already called his arm standing and asked me to check it, and I was still asking what Priya needed, so that check probably didn't happen before time ran out. Early on I also said the start belonged at the tail tip, which was the wrong end for the fall. I should have corrected that once the pad showed START on the right.

Collaboration: I kept my hands off stroke 2 while Tom redid it, and I answered calls from Priya, Tom and Leo quickly. But I repeated 'staying off stroke 2' many times, which added talk and slowed my placing. Priya's question at 9:45 got only a 'what did you need?' from me, and I should have followed it up before anything else.

Leadership: After the first minute I mostly reacted to others. Tom and Priya sorted out the tail order, and Leo took the lower arm. I could have set one clear sequence (top arm, lower arm, join checks) early on and held everyone to it, rather than waiting to be asked. I'd like to do that next time."}
